crossRefs.note: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?
He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
“Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions…
If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
Now David had said, “Surely in vain I have kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed…
Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.
Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying, “A boy is born to you,” making him very glad.
But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.
God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”
When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the…
But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

translations.web: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
translations.bsb: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.
translations.kjv: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
translations.asv: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: Fret not thyself, it tendeth only to evil-doing.
